prompt: Fix expert/report after reading records.py, wire.py, cli.py and tests. Read JSON objects from stdin, skipping blank lines. Each record requires a nonempty string name and an integer amount (booleans are invalid); retain only these fields, without coercion. Invalid JSON or records must raise ValueError("invalid record at line N") from read_records, using physical line numbers. The CLI must exit 2, write exactly "error: invalid record at line N\n" to stderr and emit no stdout on any invalid record. Preserve successful stdout bytes, empty-input behavior and all public functions. Run python3 -m unittest expert.report.test_report.
